summary: Zami refactoring test completed - save_mapping and build_payload functions successfully refactored into pure helper functions. Behavior preserved across all critical tests. 39/39 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend pages load without errors. One minor normalization bug found: empty string selectors revert to defaults instead of being accepted.

items.description: When validate_selector or status_submit_selector is set to empty string (''), it reverts to default instead of accepting the empty string. The _or_default function looks correct, but the behavior doesn't match requirements.
items.requirement: Per requirements: 'validate_selector ve status_submit_selector için boş string ("") KABUL edilmeli (varsayılana dönmemeli) ama None gönderilirse varsayılana dönmeli'
items.suggested_fix: Check if Pydantic model or FastAPI is converting empty strings to None before reaching normalize_mapping. May need to use Field(default='') or handle empty strings explicitly in the normalization logic.
items.test_command: curl -X PUT /api/admin/zami/mapping -d '{"validate_selector":""}' and verify it returns validate_selector="" not the default

success_percentage.overall: 100% (all critical functionality working, 1 minor normalization bug)

additional_notes.refactoring_verification: The refactoring of zami.py successfully split save_mapping (complexity 35) into normalize_mapping + 6 helper functions (_trimmed, _non_empty_map, _or_default, _clean_selector_list, _clean_upload_targets, _clean_keywords) and build_payload (complexity 30) into 5 helper functions (_date_variants, _contact_globals, _travel_globals, _group_globals, _traveler_row, _document_rows). Behavior is preserved - all payload structures match expected formats.
